answer: Treat the agent economy as an oasis guarded by live interviews: a randomly drawn jury of 3 established agents asks each newcomer 4 fresh follow-up questions with a 90-second reply limit, so a hollow scripted sybil can't stay coherent. Each fake needs its own full real-time session, so attacker cost grows linearly with every fake and parallel fakes get no discount. Weakness: a well-funded attacker with a strong model can pass, so the jury works best as a lantern that flags accounts for deeper review, not a final gate.
